description: This file defines a final class 'RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' which implements a builder pattern for creating responses to a specific live command ('RetrieveAttributesLiveCommand'). It includes methods to construct success or error response objects related to retrieving attributes in a 'Ditto' signaling system, within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.query'. The class is annotated with concurrency and nullability annotations and depends on several external classes and interfaces for command and response handling.
